verdict.rationale: Mastra's private model gateways let you route to self-hosted models so sensitive data does not leave your network. An env flag can block external providers so only your own gateways are selectable, which supports a no-cloud-dependency setup. However, none of the named local backends is explicitly documented, and there is no hands-on evidence of a fully offline run. Missing for 10: explicit documented support for Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio or vLLM, a confirmed end-to-end local-only setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can run the assistant entirely on local models — Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or vLLM — with no cloud model dependency

citations.quote: Self-hosting removes the third party, preventing sensitive data from reaching models outside of your network.
set `AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS=true` in your `.env` so users can only select models from your own gateways
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally
